summary: Bench sheets for the Jorvessara JO-6 amorphous dispersion work package (DL_2017_0070). The vehicle ladder ranks eight candidate vehicles, the polymer loading sheet records the shortlist in weight percent, and the stress screen shows which blend resisted recrystallisation. The blend selected on the stress screen is the basis for the larger drying run Jorvessara commissioned.

sheets.name: Blend selection
rows: Blend A (HPMC-AS grade M / PVP-VA 64, 1:1) at 30 wt% drug loading
Single phase on dispersion and no recrystallisation in the 4-week stress screen. Lowest moisture uptake of the blends tested.
PVP-VA 64 alone failed the stress screen. HPMC E5 phase-separated on dispersion.
Larger drying run on Blend A for Jorvessara. Pilot lot size to be agreed with Jorvessara; drying parameters to be frozen before the run.
